fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Sales.Deal.Delete
fields.Description: Delete any open deal that was never closed, with its unconfirmed order. Parent of MJ.BizApps.Sales.Deal.DeleteOwn, so it implies it.

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Sales.Deal.DeleteOwn
fields.Description: Delete an open, never-closed deal the user owns (Deal.OwnerEmployeeID is the user's Employee), with its unconfirmed order.
